/-- [aspis_retry_owner34::owner::retry]:
    Source: 'owner.rs', lines 6:0-13:1
    Visibility: public -/
def owner.retry
  {S : Type} {P : Type} {E : Type} {A : Type} (AttemptInst : owner.Attempt A S
  P E) (fuel : Std.Usize) (index : Std.Usize) (state : S) :
  Result (owner.Run P S E)
  := do
  if fuel = 0#usize
  then ok (owner.Run.Exhausted state)
  else
    let s ← AttemptInst.attempt index state
    match s with
    | owner.Step.Done proof after =>
      let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize)
      ok (owner.Run.Published proof i after)
    | owner.Step.Retry after =>
      let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub fuel 1#usize)
      let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize)
      owner.retry AttemptInst i i1 after
    | owner.Step.Stop error after => ok (owner.Run.Stopped error after)
partial_fixpoint

end AspisR1Retry34
